question: Which mantra formulas are assigned in the head placement context?
premises: A salutation formula to māṃvyolka is given
The head is specified as a location
A salutation formula to the lord of radiance is given
inference: The formulas māṃvyolkāya namaḥ and tejodhipataye namaḥ are assigned in relation to the head
uncertainties: Exact placement mapping of the second formula relative to śīrṣe
plain_english: On the head: māṃvyolkāya namaḥ and tejodhipataye namaḥ.
